The remaining questions refer to the following information.
Details of students in a school are stored in the STUDENT file.
A school employs administration staff. One of the tasks carried out by these staff is to maintain the
details of students in the STUDENT file.
Amendments to the student records are necessary because of:
• occasional changes to personal details
• yearly changes to information like the year and form that a student is in
• regular changes caused by things like marks in examinations needing to be updated.
Access to the data is available to teachers while most enquiries and all changes are made by the
administration staff.

indexed sequential access to the records held in the STUDENT file. Use the information
about the student records stated above.

parts.text:
Students take exams in all their subjects at the end of every year. A procedure is to be
written which inputs the marks of a student from the STUDENT file and calculates the mean
mark for that student.
Produce an algorithm which will carry out the above task. The procedure is to be called
MEAN.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The school awards a prize each year to the students who achieve the highest mean mark in
their form.
Produce an algorithm for a procedure called PRIZE which will determine which student will
win the prize for a particular form. The name of the form and the name of the student should
then be saved to a file called PRIZES.
